title: Product Analyst - Supplier Orchestration & Customer/Supplier Collaboration Solutions
jobDescription: Product Analyst - Supplier Orchestration & Customer/Supplier Collaboration Solutions Location: This position is available as a remote opportunity in the United States, but candidates in the Eastern Time Zone are highly preferred. Hybrid is also available for candidates in the Greater Philadelphia Metro Area or Atlanta, GA. Interested in a career that bridges the gap between Supply Chain and Technology? Elemica, an award-winning, digital supply chain company in the SaaS community, is seeking experienced Product Analyst to grow our business and strengthen our partnerships with existing top enterprise clients. This is an opportunity to join a growing company of talented and committed individuals, unified in the common goal of exceeding our client’s expectations. Our Values At Elemica, we believe that our success is founded on a shared set of core values that guide our decisions and actions. From our CEO to our newest entry-level employees, every member of our team is encouraged to embrace these values, which we hold in high regard. Curiosity – We delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them. Integrity – We are reliable and trustworthy, steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, customers, and partners. Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently. Passion – We have a shared enthusiasm for transforming our clients’ supply chains. What’s in it For You? Competitive Compensation Packages Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents and careers Health & Voluntary Insurance Options Paid Time Off & Holidays Retirement Savings Program & Bonus Program Quarterly Employee Engagement Events Wellness & Mental Health Initiatives Generous Employee Referral Program Flexible Work Schedule Fun Work Environment Role & Responsibilities As a Product Analyst at Elemica, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business users and technical teams for our Supplier Order Orchestration and Customer & Supplier Collaboration solutions – the products that automate procure-to-pay, vendor-managed inventory (VMI), and forecast collaboration workflows between Elemica’s clients and their trading partners. Your expertise will guide the design of business requirements, incorporating best practices, process enhancements, and data analysis to drive product excellence. At Elemica, product analysts are part of our Product organization, reporting through our Chief Product Officer. The organization operates as agile scrum teams delivering three major releases per year. We work under the mantra of “Beyond Reproach”, which means our work is so clear, we are so dependable, and we are so open that it leaves no room for doubt by our colleagues. What You’ll Do Product Strategy & Prioritization Perform analysis to assess the need for requested changes to Supplier Order Orchestration and Customer/Supplier Collaboration solutions and their impact on strategic business outcomes and company OKRs Work closely with Product Manager to determine what to prioritize, balancing development team capacity against urgency, productivity, and commercial needs Break down product features into epics, user stories, subtasks, improvements, and spikes in the product backlog and prioritize the product backlog to facilitate sprint planning and release delivery Develop detailed requirements and acceptance criteria to guide the development process Research and analyze client and market data – via customer discussions, surveys, and market research – to influence future product priorities, roadmap, and strategy Investigate new feature requirements and perform competitive analysis of purchase order management, collaboration, VMI, and forecast collaboration solutions Sprint & Release Execution Maintain accurate, up-to-date tickets and backlog hygiene, modeling responsible development practices for the team Understand and communicate the financial and operational impact of recommended changes through cost/benefit analysis and business case documentation Monitor development activities against release plans, and review and compose sprint review materials and sprint documentation Perform release communication for quarterly releases – describing new features, creating marketing and training documentation, and coordinating distribution and notifications Cross-Functional Delivery Create technical documentation on existing and new products/features to enable professional services, customer support, and sales teams Coordinate with development and solution architects to build standard and customer-specific demonstrations of Supplier Order Orchestration and Customer/Supplier Collaboration solutions Provide development with use cases for new features and collaborate with developers throughout the development cycle Understand and support the transfer of activities between Presales and Professional Services to ensure seamless delivery for clients Build team camaraderie across multiple business units through strong communication and regular touchpoints Data & Product Analytics Construct current, future, and visionary state process flow charts Estimate the potential impact of a proposed feature before it's built, and evaluate whether a launched feature delivered results after the fact Monitor product usage trends, drop-off points, and feature adoption using analytics and embedded tools like Pendo to guide ongoing product decisions What You’ll Need Basic Qualifications 2–3 years of experience as a SaaS software product analyst, or equivalent academic background in engineering, supply chain, or a related field Analysis experience using spreadsheets and database query languages Experience with business needs assessment, requirement negotiation, and user story creation Strong prioritization skills with an eye toward business and customer impact Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to liaise between technical and non-technical stakeholders Experience working with agile teams Extremely organized with strong time-management skills Proficient in using Jira, Confluence, and Pendo Passion for understanding customer behavior and driving product excellence Naturally curious, self-starter, eager to grow and learn Domain & Functional Expertise Functional knowledge of supply chain order management, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, or vendor-managed inventory (VMI) / forecast collaboration processes Understanding of B2B multi-enterprise supply chain networks and trading partner integration (EDI, API, or similar) Functional knowledge of ERP order fulfillment, logistics, manufacturing, or procurement Experience with ERP master data integration, harmonization, and validation to support order management processing is a plus Mathematical modeling experience is a strong plus, especially in transportation planning and scheduling, MRP II, demand-driven MRP, or distribution planning Preferred Qualifications Experience with SAP ECC and S/4HANA order management workflows and integration Experience with EDI and trading partner onboarding Prior experience building enterprise B2B software Experience at a private-equity-backed growth company Education Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, or a comparable field required; Master’s degree a plus Academic coursework in supply chain management, systems engineering, or operations research is a plus Logistics This position may require as much as 15% travel to customer and non-customer sites in North America and Europe. Who We Are Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of SaaS-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Today, global leaders—including Arkema, BASF, Continental, Dow, Goodyear, Michelin, and Shell—use Elemica, driving over $1 trillion in commerce annually. It is the responsibility of all Elemica employees to ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of Elemica systems and data and the data of our customers. Using best practices in these areas, all Elemica employees will observe a ‘security first’ approach to their daily responsibilities. All employees are accountable for securing their work devices, work areas, and communications in the execution of their daily duties. These qualities show up in our interactions with each other, our clients, and our collective community: Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. These qualities show up in our interactions with each other, our clients, and our collective community: Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently. Passion – We have a shared enthusiasm for transforming our clients’ supply chain Responsibilities & Objectives Elemica’s Project Managers are integral to our success and serve as trusted, dedicated advisors. Key to this role is experience in product-led implementation. We are looking for people who are self-motivated and driven to accomplish goals. Elemica values individual accountability as well as a global team approach to problem solving and knowledge sharing. What You’ll Do Project Managers at Elemica are responsible for the hands-on project management of client onboarding projects and change requests using a combination of Agile and Waterfall methodologies. Lead the requirements gathering process for the implementation of the appropriate solutions Manage coordination of the clients, partners, and working groups engaged in project work: Detailed project planning and control including: Use of Elemica Standardized PMO Toolkit (training provided) Developing and maintaining a detailed project plan Manage project deliverables in line with the project plan Record and manage project issues and risks; escalate where necessary Manage project scope and change control Monitor project progress and performance against project budgets Ongoing project management of open projects to ensure that the implementation of the Elemica solution remains current and relevant to the customers, and that opportunities for expansion of the business are identified Proactively build successful internal and external working relationships Coordinate the execution of client testing activities: Facilitate end-to-end partner testing Ensure the client and trading partners can transact on the Elemica network Take an active role in troubleshooting problems discovered during the testing process and work with internal and client resources through the resolution Understand and manage project risks, escalate where necessary and design mitigation strategies to avoid delays while meeting deadlines and staying in budget Suggest improvement efforts surrounding the processes and tools utilized in Elemica’s client onboarding process What You’ll Need 5+ years Project Management onboarding new clients in a SaaS environment and trading partner rollouts for existing clients Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Logistics, Supply Chain, or related field of study (MBA preferred) SAP ECC and/or SAP S4/HANA experience. SAP EWM experience is a plus but not required Functional knowledge of SD/WM/LE/TM modules (or some combination thereof) Experience with and functional understanding of logistics or supply chain processes Exposure to cybersecurity and networking issues and technologies Excellent organizational skills including attention-to-detail and multi-tasking skills Fluency in English (written and verbal) Use of standard PC office packages (Teams, MS Office, Excel, Word) Ability to work independently Open-minded in receiving feedback and always striving for improvement Goal-oriented, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and deliver results Your Success. Your Well-being. Our Commitment: Elemica Benefits. We're passionate about empowering our team. Our comprehensive benefits package is thoughtfully designed to support every facet of your life and career journey: Market-Leading Pay: We ensure your talent is rewarded with competitive compensation. Complete Family Health: Comprehensive health insurance to protect you and your entire family. Secure Tomorrow: Build a strong financial future with robust retirement plans including EPF, Corporate NPS, and Gratuity. Flexible Work-Life: Embrace work-life balance through our hybrid model and flexible hours. Celebrate Achievement: Our annual and quarterly recognition programs foster a high-performance culture by consistently rewarding your excellence and driving success. Support for Life's Milestones: Beyond standard annual, sick, and casual leave, we offer dedicated time off for significant life events like marriage and paternity. Who We Are Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of SaaS-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Today, global leaders—including Arkema, BASF, Continental, Dow, Goodyear, Michelin, and Shell—use Elemica, driving over $1 trillion in commerce annually. It is the responsibility of all Elemica employees to ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of Elemica systems and data and the data of our customers. Using best practices in these areas, all Elemica employees will observe a ‘security first’ approach to their daily responsibilities. All employees are accountable for securing their work devices, work areas, and communications in the execution of their daily duties. Our Values At Elemica, we believe that embodying our values is essential for all team members. These qualities show up in our interactions with each other, our clients, and our collective community: Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them Integrity – We are relatable and trustworthy; steadfast in our commitment to our colleagues, clients, and partners Accountability – We show up and deliver measurable, meaningful business value. Consistently. Passion – We have a shared enthusiasm for transforming our clients’ supply chain Introduce yourself to our recruiters and we'll get in touch if there's a role that seems like a good match.

title: Principle Software engineer , PS
jobDescription: Principle Software engineer , PS Our Business Elemica offers a state-of-the-art supply chain operating network in the areas of customer & supplier management and logistics— promoting new levels of efficiency and profitability for a leaner and more fully optimized supply chain. Elemica’ s clients achieve significant value from reduced cost of operations, faster process execution with fewer resources through the automation of key business processes, removal of transactional barriers, and seamless information flow between business partners. Our Values All members of the Elemica team from our CEO to our newest entry-level employees are expected to adhere to a set of core values that we think are critically important to our success. Trust and Respect Growth and Development Communication and Collaboration Accountability and Ownership Job Responsibilities: Principle Integration Consultant: Create and enforce best practices. Poses the knowledge of industry-standard implementations. Communicate/Work with the Client to generate a blueprint. Breaking down the blueprint provided to convert to Project action items. Mentor the team on best practices and Industry knowledge. Some level of SAP functionality. Accountability: Lead maintenance of customer solutions in partnership with the Global Customer Support and OnSite teams Responsibility: Drive quality across enhancements and fixes delivered. Analytical: Lead impact analysis, change control, pull request, code review, and change management. Quality: Maintain version control for the solution. Visionary: Drive automation mindset across the SET organization. Self-Driven: Hire, motivate, and retain a team of analysts and engineers. Create and drive a high-performing team. Develop team members and yourself. EDI Knowledge: The developer should have a strong understanding of EDI standards such as ANSI X12, EDIFACT, or other relevant formats. They should be familiar with EDI transaction sets, segments, and elements. Mapping Tools Proficiency: Proficiency in EDI mapping tools like IBM Sterling B2B Integrator, Gentran Integration Suite, Cleo Clarify, or other similar software is essential. Programming Languages: Knowledge of programming languages like Java, Python, or JavaScript is often required to develop custom mapping logic and integration with other systems. Data Transformation: The ability to perform data transformation between EDI formats and various internal data formats (e.g., XML, JSON, flat files) is crucial. Industry Experience: Familiarity with the specific industries where EDI is commonly used (e.g., retail, healthcare, logistics) is a plus as different industries may have specific EDI requirements. EDI Communication Protocols: Understanding of communication protocols used in EDI, such as AS2, SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS, VAN, etc. Error Handling and Validation: Experience in handling errors and implementing validation rules to ensure data integrity and compliance with EDI standards. Testing and Troubleshooting: Ability to conduct thorough testing of EDI maps and troubleshoot issues that arise during testing or production. Documentation Skills: Clear and detailed documentation of EDI maps, mapping rules, and procedures is essential for knowledge sharing and future maintenance. Compliance and Security: Awareness of EDI compliance requirements and data security best practices to protect sensitive information during transmission and processing. Collaboration: Effective communication and collaboration skills are essential as EDI map developers often work closely with business analysts, trading partners, and IT teams. Adaptability: Willingness to adapt to changing EDI standards, technologies, and business requirements. Project Management: For more senior roles, experience in managing EDI mapping projects and ensuring timely delivery of solutions. Continuous Learning: Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in EDI standards, technologies, and best practices. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills to understand complex data structures and efficiently design EDI maps. Coach: Management experience with leading a team, should be able to learn new concepts and teach the rest of the team. Skills: JavaScript and XSLT ANSI X12 and EDIFACT, IDOCS. B2B integration Experience Experience with JIRA and GIT Hub Qualification: Programming Languages: JavaScript, XSLT.
